page.content:
Allied program that built the bombs used on Japan.

How Manhattan Project connects

  • Event: Hiroshima — The Manhattan Project built the bomb used on Hiroshima.
  • Event: Nagasaki — The Manhattan Project built the bomb used on Nagasaki.

What is Manhattan Project?

The Manhattan Project was the U.S.-led industrial and scientific effort that produced the first nuclear weapons, used at Hiroshima and Nagasaki in August 1945.

Key threads lead to Hiroshima and Nagasaki.
